column1: # render rules 11 and 13 on the licence of the data feed (Replikanti/interviewscam#19,
# ADR-0010 parts 6 and 7), one row per branch and per kind of change, on a
# copy of render/pass-feed (search_cases_runner in tools/selftest.sh, the
# feed rules on because that case has a feed.txt). The license object is
# pinned by const in schema/feed.schema.json (rule 11); /data-feed/ must
# hold a visible <code> reading license.id, a visible <a> whose href is
# exactly license.url and whose text is exactly license.name, and as the
# first element with the fragment of license.terms_url as its id a visible
# <h2> whose section holds that link; no page links the licence's host
# otherwise (rule 13). Replikanti/interviewscam#60 adds two families: the
# licence's host after a special scheme with no slash, with backslashes or
# padded (one page-second-cc-link-slashless-<scheme> row per member of
# SPECIAL_HOST_SCHEMES), and a section that ends at an <h1> or <h2> nested
# at any depth (one page-link-after-nested-<tag> row per member of
# SECTION_END_TAGS); render-feed/coverage takes both sets from the code.
# name, file, find, replace, expect (PASS, COUNT=<n> <text> or <text>),
# then optional find and replace pairs. Every find string occurs exactly
# once in its file; \u{XXXX} is that code point, \t a tab and \n a newline.
